meta.title: Kasilapa Bay — Beachfront Homestay in Tomia, Wakatobi
meta.description: A peaceful beachfront homestay on Tomia Island, Wakatobi. Discover pristine reefs, white sand beaches, and genuine local hospitality.

hero.subtitle: A simple homestay in Tomia, Wakatobi. where crystal-clear waters meet warm hospitality.

about.headline: Ultimate Comfort in Tomia Island
about.description: Kasilapa Bay is the best accommodation in Wakatobi, blending restful comfort, friendly service, and affordable pricing. Whether you are a backpacker, traveler, or a family vacationing together, Kasilapa Bay brings a warm home-away-from-home atmosphere.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.subtitle: Comfortable rooms with direct views of the Wakatobi blue.

rooms.name: Deluxe Junior Suite
rooms.description: This room type is the most economical option, usually intended for solo travelers or couples who want standard accommodation.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A mid-range room type with slightly more spacious dimensions and more comfortable furnishings for resting after a full day of diving.

rooms.name: Deluxe Double
rooms.description: The best room type at Kasilapa Bay, highly recommended as it offers the best position and view directly overlooking the bay.

destination.title: Nearby Destinations
destination.subtitle: Explore the natural wonders and cultural heritage around Tomia Island.

places.name: Hondue Beach
places.description: Just a 5-minute drive from Kasilapa Bay. This beach has calm, clear water and fine white sand, making it perfect for swimming and enjoying the sunset.

places.name: Kahianga Peak
places.description: The highest point on Tomia. with endless blue ocean view, beautiful sunset, and lush tropical forest.

places.name: Roma
places.description: One of the world's most famous wall dives. A vertical reef dropping to 80 meters, teeming with marine life.

places.name: Nata Fortress
places.description: An ancient fortress from the Buton Kingdom, still standing strong. A testament to the island's maritime heritage.

places.name: Huntete Beach
places.description: Located in the eastern part of Tomia Island. It has white sand and clear sea water. If you are lucky, tourists can also see whales swimming not far from the beach.

places.name: Patua Fortress
places.description: Located on a hilltop, this fortress offers a stunning view from green hills to the vast blue ocean. Built during the kingdom era, Patua Fortress stands as a silent witness to the long history of civilization in Wakatobi.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.subtitle: A glimpse of the beauty of Kasilapa Bay and its surroundings.

reviews.title: Guest Reviews
reviews.subtitle: What our guests say about their stay at Kasilapa Bay.

items.name: Andi Pratama
items.comment: Incredibly peaceful. The reef is right in front of the homestay. The host is very friendly and the food is authentic. Will definitely return.

items.name: Sarah Mitchell
items.comment: One of the best places I've ever visited. Crystal-clear water, healthy coral reefs, and a tranquility that's hard to find anywhere else.

items.name: Budi Setiawan
items.comment: A truly memorable stay. The kids loved snorkeling right from the beach. Simple facilities but clean and comfortable.

items.name: Yuki Tanaka
items.comment: Diving at Roma Wall is unmatched. And coming back to Kasilapa Bay after a dive feels like coming home. A very special place.
